2609.27637.title: Learning Local Heterogeneity and Cross-Region Context for Large-Scale Traffic Forecasting
2609.27637.paper_summary: Traffic flow forecasting is essential to intelligent transportation systems. Large-scale traffic forecasting requires jointly modeling local spatial dependencies and cross-region context.Spatial dependencies between geographically neighboring nodes are heterogeneous due to differences in road identity and travel direction, while acquiring global information through allpairs node interactions incurs substantial computational costs. Therefore, capturing local heterogeneity while efficiently acquiring long-range context remains an important challenge in largescale traffic forecasting. To address these challenges, we propose LoReST, a Local-Region Spatial Temporal network that models spatial dependencies at two complementary granularities: node neighborhoods and road network regions. Specifically, relation-aware local aggregation captures heterogeneous dependencies within geographic neighborhoods through road and direction specific feature transformations. Cross-region interaction constructs region representations through mean pooling, exchanges long range context via inter-region attention, and broadcasts it back to nodes. By integrating local information aggregation with crossregion interaction, LoReST is able to effectively achieve spatial dependency learning in large-scale road networks. Experiments on four datasets of the LargeST benchmark show average relative reductions of 4.78%, 3.60%, and 5.75% in MAE, RMSE, and MAPE, respectively.
2609.27637.paper_summary_zh: 交通流量預測對於智慧交通系統至關重要。大規模交通預測需要共同建模當地空間依賴性和跨區域上下文。由於道路身份和行駛方向的差異，地理相鄰節點之間的空間依賴性是異質的，而通過所有節點交互獲取全局信息則會產生相當大的計算成本。因此，在大規模交通預測中，捕捉當地異質性同時有效獲取長距離上下文仍然是一個重要挑戰。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了LoReST，一種局部-區域空間時間網絡，該網絡在兩個互補的粒度上建模空間依賴性：節點鄰域和道路網絡區域。具體而言，關係感知的局部聚合通過道路和方向特定的特徵轉換捕捉地理鄰域內的異質依賴性。跨區域交互通過均值池化構建區域表示，通過區域間注意力交換長距離上下文，並將其廣播回節點。通過將局部信息聚合與跨區域交互相結合，LoReST能夠有效地實現大規模道路網絡中的空間依賴性學習。在LargeST基準的四個數據集上的實驗顯示，MAE、RMSE和MAPE的平均相對減少分別為4.78%、3.60%和5.75%。
